gloss: to pass; to go by; to be over

definitions.gloss: to pass; to go by; to be over
definitions.explanation: Of time, an era, an event or a storm: to pass and be gone, leaving it in the past.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{過|す}ぎ{去|さ}った。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{過|す}ぎ{去|さ}って、⟦{青空|あおぞら}→青空：10084_aozora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: The typhoon passed and the blue sky returned.

examples.japanese: {過|す}ぎ{去|さ}った⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Thinking back on days gone by fills me with nostalgia.

notes:
⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (to pass) + ⟦{去|さ}る→去る：02115_saru⟧ (to leave); stresses that something is gone for good. Often in the past form before a noun: {過|す}ぎ{去|さ}った⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ "a bygone era."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時|とき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{過|す}ぎ{去|さ}る: time passes
- ⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{過|す}ぎ{去|さ}る: a storm passes
- {過|す}ぎ{去|さ}った⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧: days gone by

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to pass; the plain word, also for passing a place
- ⟦{去|さ}る→去る：02115_saru⟧: to leave; {過|す}ぎ{去|さ}る adds the sense of time running out
